summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change switched payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable, so orders were processed without payment. Order worker stalled in a wait state (heartbeat age ~8-14s) with 36 orders stuck in the queue; the cause of the stall is not known.
recommended: Validate the payments-v2 endpoint and its reachability before retrying the migration.
Investigate why the worker stalled in the wait state.
Alert on orders_without_payment and on provider failures logged at DEBUG.

version: v1.3

I see two problems here: provider v2 is unreachable, and a worker is stuck waiting with a queue depth of 36. I'll revert the config back to v1 first, then restart the worker and reprocess the queue.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
